text: We build personal knowledge bases to free our minds, but we rarely account for the hidden "organization tax." Every hour spent meticulously tagging notes, refining backlinks, or perfecting layouts is an hour stolen from actual creation. If you aren't careful, your digital garden becomes a graveyard of unfinished ideas rather than an engine for deep thought. Your system should serve your curiosity, not become a second job. Don't let the administrative overhead of managing your knowledge prevent you from actually using it.
